explanation.headline: FDA's records show digoxin has been on the shortage list for 65 months as of 2026-10-21; the Hikma Portugal plant tied to one label was classified OAI in 2014 and received a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21, while the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant tied to another label was classified OAI in 2009 and received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08

sentences.text: As of 2026-10-21 the digoxin shortage has been on FDA's list for 65 months since the original posting on 2021-06-04.
One labeled product names HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. as the manufacturing plant, which FDA inspected on 2014-03-28 and classified OAI with six observations.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to that Hikma Portugal facility on 2014-10-21.
Another labeled product names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the plant, which FDA inspected on 2009-06-11 and classified OAI with six observations.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to Bryant Ranch Prepack on 2010-04-08.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Covis Pharma US, Inc. (plant AZURITY), which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Corvale East has 11 days on hand and Corvale General has 15 days on hand at current usage rates.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-8475c8.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%digoxin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%digoxin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-7b111a.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('3933b07f-5857-4a80-b502-e3214bdf9330', 'e61d2108-d871-44c0-b12a-2e61fbb56967', '58f45aba-ff6f-43cc-bb88-be40a9f7beda') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-96d723.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%digoxin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-b73c09.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%digoxin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-347429.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%digoxin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-02c7cf.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002807173', '1000519407') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-d87c8a.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002807173', '1000519407') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-6277e1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002807173', '1000519407') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica s a', 'sandoz', 'bryant ranch prepack')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-8243c2.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica s a', 'sandoz', 'bryant ranch prepack', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%digoxin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-88ac40.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('590126', '876911') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-c563ac.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00641141035', '71335315603', '00781305995')
